profile.normal: opt-level=s, ThinLTO, 16 CGUs, stripped, PIE, normal unwinding
profile.compact: Same objects plus safe identical-code folding and DT_RELR on x86-64 GNU/Linux
profile.fat: The final crate uses opt-level=s with FatLTO and one CGU over the same release archives. Both link outputs are recorded.

compiler.cargo_wall_scope: The build reused the production dependency cache. Elapsed Cargo wall time includes resource reservation while other measured binaries were built. Per-compiler-unit elapsed starts after its resource gate.

fat.cpu_scope: CPU includes the separately timed address-map capture.

property.scope: Public i32 property/observer operations on four concrete host classes, Linux x86-64, single thread. Cases do not exercise rendering or all possible property payload types.
property.toolchain: rustc 1.99.0 with opt-level=s, unwinding, PIE, safe identical-code folding and RELR. Thin used 16 codegen units; whole-program Fat used one final-crate codegen unit. Compiler and source features were preserved.

timings.description: Each 24-block cycle uses every permutation of four binaries once, in shuffled order. Each block is followed immediately by its reverse. All eight processes in a block use the same workload rotation. Medians of within-block candidate/reference CPU ratios with 4000-resample percentile bootstrap intervals (95%).
